text:
sara_sales: Heads-up: Prospect Helios wants a 72h BYO-HSM POC. Main asks: rotation dry-run, attestation artifacts, and cost transparency for proxy ops.
devon_se: I'll scope the runbook. Two modes: 1) proxy-only, 2) hybrid with local KEK cache. Targets: 6k ops/sec, median RTT <60ms.
vendor_infra: We'll attach a rented HSM for POC. For proxy fallback we need mTLS and a short grace window during rotation.
akshay_eng: Config knobs: `grace_period_ms` (default 120000) and `cache_ttl_ms`. Recommend cache_ttl_ms=45000 for hybrid.
sara_sales: Billing question: can we zero-rate a limited dry-run rotation period? They hate surprise overages.
ops_bot: Note: Sales can authorize a trial-credit token. If applied, proxy egress ops up to capped amount are zero-rated. Request trial token via Sales Ops before test.
maria_legal: SOW items: 90d attestation retention, JSONL rotation logs, and explicit carve-outs for third-party HSM provider downtime.
devon_se: Example admin API for key import: ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/v1/keys/import -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -F 'key=@cmk.pem'```
vendor_infra: Need to see sample attestation output format to satisfy internal auditors.
akshay_eng: We'll produce a sample JSONL attestation: `{"ts":"2026-05-01T12:00:00Z","evt":"attestation","cmk":"cmk-hl-01","stmt":"BASE64..."}` and a `rotation-check` script.
sara_sales: Actions: @akshay_eng provide attestation sample + bench binary, @devon_se publish runbook, @vendor_infra send firewall egress list by EOD Wed, @sara_sales request trial token.
sara_sales: Thanks all — will update once Sales Ops confirms token.
